verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own docs state that it detects NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs and downloads the matching backend, which directly covers running models across GPU vendors with vendor-tailored acceleration. Missing for 10: the specific kernel stacks (e.g. CUDA, ROCm, SYCL/oneAPI) are never named, there is no in-depth per-vendor setup or performance documentation, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: LocalAI automatically detects your system's GPU capabilities (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the appropriate backend.
